truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.33.0; fixed in 2.33.0 (a CA bundle extracted from a zip is written to a predictable, reusable temp path).

Fix commit 66d21cb 'Merge commit from fork' (GitHub's message for a private security fix), in tag v2.33.0 and not in v2.32.5. https://github.com/psf/requests/commit/66d21cb07bd6255b1280291c4fafb71803cdb3b7
extract_zipped_paths: the os.path.join(tempdir, name) + atomic_open block is replaced by tempfile.mkstemp.

Entry points: HTTPAdapter.send calls cert_verify (src/requests/adapters.py line 616 at v2.32.5), which calls extract_zipped_paths(DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH) (line 300), so every request path reaches it. extract_zipped_paths is itself public.
